summary: Livingston Parish, LA tower burned in September 1974 after a fallen pole shorted a line; a tower stood until a March 2018 teardown per Wikipedia and WBRZ.

facts.status_note: A 1974 account says fire destroyed the tower; Wikipedia and WBRZ report a tower torn down in March 2018. The sources do not say whether it was rebuilt

events.note: Towerman Colyear Zeigler was on duty when the fire started
Newspaper account dated September 5, 1974: a telephone pole fell and shorted a line, setting the tower on fire; instruments and a two-way radio burned
Wikipedia: removed March 2018; WBRZ: torn down Monday, March 12, 2018

evidence.quote: Long retired, the tower was removed in March 2018.

evidence.supports: fire district posted a video of the tower coming down
evidence.quote: Livingston Parish Fire Protection District #2 posted a video on Facebook of it coming down

evidence.supports: tower destroyed by fire after a telephone pole shorted the line
evidence.quote: the commission's Springville fire tower was destroyed when a telephone pole fell down and shorted out the line, setting the tower on fire

evidence.supports: towerman Colyear Zeigler got down unhurt
evidence.quote: The towerman, Colyear Zeigler, was able to scamper down the escape uninjured

evidence.supports: fire district says the retired Springville tower was torn down on a Monday
evidence.quote: the retired Springville fire tower was torn down Monday

evidence.supports: tower had been retired for many years
evidence.quote: the tower had been retired for many years leading up to Monday's takedown

evidence.supports: account credited to the Lake Charles American-Press
tower burned along with its instruments and a two-way radio
evidence.quote: the tower burned, along with tower instruments and a two-way radio set

evidence.supports: fire district reported the retired tower was torn down
evidence.quote: According to the Livingston Parish Fire Protection District #2

sources.title: List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana
WATCH: Local landmark torn down in Livingston Parish

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia gives March 2018 and WBRZ dates the teardown to Monday, March 12, 2018, so the two agree on the month and year

notes_for_editor: The 1974 account calls the tower destroyed, but a tower was torn down in March 2018. No source read says whether it was rebuilt after the fire, so the story leaves that open. The 1974 text is quoted through the Central US Lookouts page, which credits the Lake Charles American-Press; the original paper was not read. A Facebook post from Livingston Parish Fire Protection District #2 (search snippet only) corroborates the takedown but was not readable, so it is not cited. Suggest asking the fire district whether the 2018 structure was original or a replacement.
